第53章 态度大转变的蔡怡农-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

终于忍不住？

他没想到刘施施能坚持这么久。

《体面》MV早就发布，这姑娘却和没事人一样。

除了打电话恭喜，就是日常聊天，没有再说别的。

他和糖嫣在MV有吻戏。

瞎姐居然没有第一时间质问。

敢情是想当面说。

“一般吧，就是同事关系。”

“嘿嘿，和漂亮姑娘拍吻戏什么感觉？有我的嘴软吗？”

刘施施眉眼弯弯，笑着问出一个致命问题。

在停顿的几秒钟，魏老板想了很多。

别看现在气氛融洽，如果下一句回答错误，他今晚只能自己睡。

这个时候绝对不能慌，更不能顾左右而言他。

“刘施施，你在质疑我的专业素养吗？”

“我是一名演员！！”

表情认真，眼神专注，语气冷峻。

三个要素把瞎姐问不会了。

不到22岁的刘施施皱着眉头，心里没底。

不对啊，你怎么不按套路出牌！！

按照老妈建议。

你现在应该磕磕碰碰的解释，然后我骂你一顿，你道歉保证再也不犯。

这样才对啊。

以前老妈都是这样对付老爸，怎么到我这里就不灵了？

察觉到气氛不对，她马上撒娇。

“我就随便问问，好奇嘛。”

轻轻摸了摸她的额头，柔声安慰：“我知道你在想什么，我和她只是同事关系，以后都不会有机会见面。不用想太多。”

“嗯...我知道...我就是心里不舒服。”

“没事，我等会让你很舒服。”

“去你的...”

两人很快打情骂俏起来。

刘施施虽然对这番解释不满意，可就像魏沐说的那样，他们只是拍了一次MV。

如果没有工作，都不知道什么时候下次见面。

夜幕下，出租车很快开进上戏附近的某个小区。

这地方是瞎姐亲自选的，环境不错，交通方便，最重要的是不起眼。

他男人好歹是个明星，肯定不能住在太扎眼的地方。

现阶段，两人的恋情不能曝光。

“铛铛铛....怎么样？”

在客厅转了一圈的刘施施，满脸期待的看着男友。

“很好。”

Finally couldn't help it?

He didn't expect Liu Shishi to persist for so long.

The MV for "Decent" has been released a long time ago, but this girl is like a normal person.

Apart from calling to congratulate and chatting daily, nothing else was said.

He and Tang Yan had a kissing scene in the MV.

The blind sister actually didn't question her immediately.

I want to say it face to face.

"Normally, it's just a relationship between colleagues."

"Hey, how does it feel to film a kissing scene with a beautiful girl? Are you as soft-spoken as me?"

Liu Shishi's eyebrows were crooked, and he asked a fatal question with a smile.

During the few seconds of pause, Boss Wei thought a lot.

Despite the harmonious atmosphere now, if the next sentence is answered incorrectly, he will have to sleep alone tonight.

You must not panic at this time, let alone talk about him left and right.

"Liu Shishi, are you questioning my professionalism?"

"I'm an actor!!"

The expression is serious, the eyes are focused, and the tone is cold.

The three elements make the blind sister unable to ask questions.

Liu Shishi, who was less than 22 years old, frowned and felt uncertain.

That's not right, why don't you play according to the routine?!

Follow mom's advice.

Now you should explain in a stumbling manner, and then I scold you, and you apologize and promise not to do it again.

This is right.

Mom used to treat dad like this, so why doesn't it work for me?

Sensing something was wrong in the atmosphere, she immediately acted coquettishly.

"I'm just asking, out of curiosity."

He gently touched her forehead and comforted her softly: "I know what you are thinking. She and I are just colleagues and we will never have the chance to meet in the future. Don't think too much."

"Well...I know...I just feel uncomfortable."

"It's okay, I'll make you feel comfortable later."

"Fuck you..."

The two soon started flirting.

Although Liu Shishi was not satisfied with this explanation, as Wei Mu said, they only shot the MV once.

If I don’t have a job, I don’t know when we will see each other next time.

Under nightfall, the taxi quickly drove into a community near Shangxi.

This place was chosen by Blind Sister herself. It has a good environment, convenient transportation, and most importantly, it is inconspicuous.

His man is a star after all, so he must not live in a place that is too eye-catching.

At this stage, the relationship between the two cannot be exposed.

"Dang Dang Dang...How about it?"

Liu Shishi walked around the living room and looked at her boyfriend expectantly.

"Very good."
